item.description: Stokes and Jacks Stand Firm: England Fights Back in Ashes Thriller In a gripping session at the Gabba, England's Ben Stokes and Will Jacks showcased resilience, remaining not out and adding crucial runs to their side's tally.At tea on day four of the second Ashes Test, England stood at 193 for six, challenging Australia's bowlers under scorching conditions.
